description: Average Transit Speeds by Stop is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. All day and peak transit 20th, 50th, and 80th percentile speeds on segments estimated on a single day for all CA transit operators that provide GTFS real-time vehicle positions data. Segments are primarily stop to stop, but if stops are farther than 1km apart, additional segments between those stops will be added at 1km intervals. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Transportation, Transit, GTFS, GTFS RT, real time, speeds, vehicle positions, Caltrans. The bounding box given is -124.2264,32.7198,-114.5626,41.9569. The hub shows 2026-08-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
